howTo: Put each picture in this folder (public/assets/saga/) and write its file name below, then reload the board. A slot left as null keeps the built-in placeholder, and nothing is downloaded for it. kneel: Mr. Saymaz kneeling with his arms open (640 × 1120, same framing as his other poses), used in the hug. hug: the hug illustration (about 1600 × 900), shown full-screen at the end of the hug.
